purpose: Small real-weight Ascend pipeline validation of temporal Self Forcing + DMD for the H3 refiner
precision: BF16 model input and transformer blocks; original FP32 projection/time/output islands, Sharp curves, and Euler state
draft_source: Real video reduced to 336x192, encoded with the official H3 VAE; no text-to-video draft generation in this smoke
temporal_history: student generated, clean H3 time 1, detached; prefix recomputation
generator_attention: block causal; static text/audio cannot read video
student_and_fake_adapters: Independent rank-8 LoRA on 200 transformer q/k/v/out projections; all released refiner weights frozen
trained_blocks: Cycle through truncated prefixes ending at block 0,1,2; only terminal block has loss
scope_limits: This is a smoke experiment, not a 2K quality or convergence evaluation
Reference upscaler and VAE are not strictly temporally causal
One denoising step per temporal block still requires three transformer calls for the entire 13-latent-frame clip
Prefix recomputation implements training semantics but is not a KV-cache speed benchmark
The small holdout is disjoint within this experiment only
Pure DMD has no explicit paired reconstruction or LR-fidelity loss
